title: Nashville Good Vibes/Walk to Broadway /Pool & Gym
description:
Howdy! Welcome to your stylish Nashville retreat. Where good vibes, comfort and convenience come together perfectly. This beautifully designed space offers a calm and relaxing atmosphere with modern touches, cozy bedding, and chic decor that makes you feel at home. Whether you’re visiting for a girls’ trip, weekend getaway, concert, sports event or relaxing staycation, this space was created for comfort and memorable moments.

The space
⭐️Walking distance to Broadway 
* 10 minutes drive from Nashville International Airport (7.2 miles) 
*Walking distance to: 
Honky Tonks @ Broadway 
Nissan stadium 
Bridgestone arena
The glutch center 
Ryman auditorium 
Johnny Cash Museum 
The convention center 
Live music 
And more 

Studio apartment: 
-2 comfortable queen size beds 
-1 full size air bed stored in the closet (can comfortably fit up to 2 people) 
-Smart Tv 
-High speed WiFi 

Kitchen: 
Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances, stocked with cookware including pots, dishware, silverware, glassware. Also has coffee maker, blender, toaster and dishwasher.

Bathroom: 
-Full size mirror 
-Blow dryer
-First aid kit 
-Body wash, conditioner, and shampoo
-Makeup remover wipes

*Parking available for $30/ per night

Permit #2018062984

Guest access
-Keyless access provided via Door / Latch app! 

-Enjoy exclusive access to the entire apartment and the luxury amenities of the property, including pool, two level gym w/ yoga studio and rock climbing wall, lounge areas and grill. All property amenities and common areas are shared.

Other things to note
-Dedicated parking spot in a secured garage for $30/night

-Overnight concierge available 10:00pm to 6:00am

-Bellhop service provided by the building 9am to 5pm

-NO GLASS in the pool. The property will charge you a fine

-No smoking in the building. The property will charge you a fine

-Guest phone should be charged and available to enter the property / unit. This building is keyless and uses the Door / Latch app
